silhouette.reason: Wood boxcar with outside bracing, running board, brake wheel, arch-bar trucks: the type reads in SIDE and 3/4.
fixes: thicker brake staff and a spoked brake wheel so the B end reads in the FRONT view

proportions.reason: 13.4 × 3.0 × 4.1 m, door and brace spacing match a builder photo by eye.
fixes: check truck side-frame spacing against the FRONT view of the builder photo

materials.reason: Painted boards, a weathered grey running board and dark iron separate well; but the road-name lettering is chopped into pieces by the diagonal braces at 3/4 (it reads as broken text in hero.png).
fixes: paint the lettering onto the brace faces too (or flush-mount it) so the road name reads unbroken at 3/4

detail.reason: Board seams, braces, door track, grab irons and trucks are there; the end wall's scattered dark slots are now regular rows of grab irons, but there is no door hasp/seal, no journal-box lids and no roof seam caps.
fixes: door hasp, seal pin and door stops; journal-box lids
roof seam caps over the board joints

wear.reason: Faded paint and light grime at the sill only; no rust streaks, no replaced boards, no chalk marks.
fixes: road grime rising from the sill (double strength below 1 m) and rust streaks under the door track and bolts
a few replaced boards in fresher paint and chalk car-card marks by the door

lod.reason: FAR LOD2 keeps the box and brace pattern; the lettering is now a dull pink stencil block instead of a bright white bar, but it still reads as one smeared stripe across the braces, and the roof boards vanish.
fixes: darken the LOD2 stencil block toward the lettering's average over the red so it stops reading as a stripe
keep the roof board seams as darker per-face stripes at LOD2

technical.reason: QA clean; 19k / 7.5k / 1.1k triangles; 13 draws for moving trucks/doors is reasonable.
fixes: merge static stencil pieces into the body to cut LOD0 draws
